LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TIII.label: tenebral pistol
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_Autopistol_TIII.description: A deceptively simplistic handgun, Tenebrite Crystal shards fired at high velocity are deathly no matter the size. This weapon is lethal, but comparatively weak within the Tenebral Dominion's armories.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TIII.label: tenebral chain shotgun
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_ChainShotgun_TIII.description:
A fully automatic shotgun reinforced with Tenebrite Crystals, often employed by Dominion death troopers who need to cut through hordes of enemy infantry like a scythe through wheat.
"Rip and Tear, until it is done." -Standard Issue Tenebral Infantryman's Primer, Page 7 - Section Gamma
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TIII.label: tenebral assault rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_AssaultRifle_TIII.description: A black rifle with blood-red highlights, capable of consistently and accurately firing bolts of Tenebrite downrange. Often colloquially called a "Hellgun" by enemies of the Tenebral Domain, it is uncertain if more have been killed with the weapon or over the privilege of using one.
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TIII.label: tenebral sniper rifle
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_SniperRifle_TIII.description: "It is not my place to say, but if the Tenebral Dominion wishes for someone to die, they use one of these bad boys, and that person f*@#ing dies." -Kwazaari Arms Dealer Ma'ash Dul'a
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_LMG_TIII.label: tenebral lmg
LanguageData.BOR_Gun_LMG_TIII.description: A belt-fed Tenebral LMG made from high-grade Tenebrite components. This upgraded design improves output and handling while reducing the drawbacks of the kwazaari predecessor.
